options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don’t park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action shown is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns you about upcoming road hazards. It alerts you that buggies may be ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that people may be crossing the street. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash through it means an action is not allowed. This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign tells you which direction traffic flows on a one-way street. You must drive in the direction shown.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers turning left on a green light that they must let oncoming traffic go first. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a sharp right turn is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway is starting. The road splits into two separate one-way roads with a median between them. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign is posted at traffic lights. It means you cannot turn right when the light is red at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you a lane is ending. Prepare to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you the road curves right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles pass. Only stop if necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you traffic is merging from the right. Prepare to allow them to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign warns you a steep downhill section is ahead. Slow down to avoid brake damage or a collision.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign marks a bicycle crossing or path. Drive carefully because bicycles regularly cross or travel in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond-shaped warning sign alerts you that wet pavement ahead may be slippery. Drive with extra caution because your vehicle will be harder to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond-shaped warning sign tells you a divided highway is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns the shoulder is lower than the road. If your wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or steer sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the right lane is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An 'Exit only' sign means that lane leads off the freeway as a ramp. You must either exit or change lanes. You cannot stay in that lane and continue on the freeway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: This yellow diamond-shaped warning sign alerts you that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This eight-sided red sign means you must come to a complete stop. Look for traffic and pedestrians, then proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a yield sign is coming. Be prepared to slow down or stop to let other drivers and pedestrians go first.

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows you which direction traffic must go. You can only drive in the direction the arrow points.

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will make a sharp right turn followed by a sharp left turn. Slow down and be ready for these curves.

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
